6.114 rsInvalidToggleItem
rsInvalidToggleItem is a critical error that occurs whenever a report item’s Visibility.ToggleItem
element is not a Textbox that is in the same scope or in a scope containing the report item, or if the
report item’s grouping scope does not contain a Group.Parent element.
